subject: general
question: Who among the following has been the longest-serving chief minister of an Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pawan Kumar Chamling**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pawan Kumar Chamling** has been the longest-serving chief minister of an Indian state.
 
• He served as the Chief Minister of Sikkim from **December 12, 1994, to May 27, 2019**.
 
• His tenure lasted for more than **24 years**, making him the longest-serving chief minister in the history of India.
 
• Chamling is the founder of the **Sikkim Democratic Front (SDF)** political party.
 
• Under his leadership, Sikkim saw significant progress in various sectors, including education, healthcare, and tourism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mulayam Singh Yadav** served as the **Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh** for** three non-consecutive terms** but did not surpass Chamling's tenure.
 
• **Narendra Modi** served as the **Chief Minister of Gujarat from 2001 to 2014** before becoming the Prime Minister of India.
 
• **Shivraj Singh Chouhan** has served multiple terms as the** Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh** but his cumulative tenure is less than that of Chamling.
 
• Other chief ministers have had long tenures, but none have exceeded Chamling's record.
